# NonDesigner

> NonDesigner is a PrestaShop module that adds a 2D graphic designer (product customizer/editor) to the product page: customers add text, images, shapes, fonts and QR codes, and for every order the module generates print-ready vector SVG and 1:1 PNG files, downloadable from the Back Office. Compatible with PrestaShop 1.7.6.1 to 8.x and 9.x, PHP 7.2 to 8.5. Supports front/back printing, Multistore and locally served fonts (no external font loading). Developed by Media Web.

Documentation available in English, German, Spanish, French and Italian (Polish in preparation). Dokumentation auf Deutsch verfügbar. Documentación disponible en español. Documentazione disponibile in inglese, tedesco, spagnolo, francese e italiano.

- [Overview and index](https://github.com/mediawebx/nondesigner-prestashop-docs/blob/main/docs/en/README.md): features, requirements, useful links
- [How to install the NonDesigner module on PrestaShop](https://github.com/mediawebx/nondesigner-prestashop-docs/blob/main/docs/en/installation.md): system requirements, compatibility, installation, license
- [How to configure the module (global settings)](https://github.com/mediawebx/nondesigner-prestashop-docs/blob/main/docs/en/module-configuration.md): logging, image upload limits, SVG shapes, fonts, designer panels and tools, abandoned cart cleanup
- [How to configure the designer on a product](https://github.com/mediawebx/nondesigner-prestashop-docs/blob/main/docs/en/product-configuration.md): enabling, front/back printing, product shape, rounded corners, PDF template, bulk apply to a category
- [How to set print dimensions](https://github.com/mediawebx/nondesigner-prestashop-docs/blob/main/docs/en/product-dimensions.md): bleed margin and sizing methods (fixed, distinct attributes, paired values W x H)
- [Orders and print-ready SVG export](https://github.com/mediawebx/nondesigner-prestashop-docs/blob/main/docs/en/orders-and-svg-export.md): design in the Back Office, SVG/JSON/PNG download, Multistore security
- [Pricing and variants of personalized products](https://github.com/mediawebx/nondesigner-prestashop-docs/blob/main/docs/en/pricing-and-variants.md): surcharges through PrestaShop combinations
- [FAQ and troubleshooting](https://github.com/mediawebx/nondesigner-prestashop-docs/blob/main/docs/en/faq.md)
